verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says the SDK is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs. The models docs let you select providers per run or per agent, mix them across agents, and set a default model through OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL. The docs also flag feature differences: built-in hosted tools (web search, file search, code interpreter) are tied to OpenAIResponsesModel, so swapping providers can cost those capabilities. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how non-OpenAI providers are configured, parity guidance for hosted tools on other providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of provider swapping.
